description: This file defines the interface for the TextReader class, which provides functionality to read text data from a DataElement, including reading lines and managing internal state.

classes.name: TextReader
classes.description: A class that facilitates reading text data from a DataElement, supporting operations like resetting, checking end of text, and reading lines.

methods.name: TextReader()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the reader at position zero with an empty DataElement.

methods.name: TextReader(DataElement& element, const uint32_t offset = 0)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reader with a DataElement and an optional starting offset.

methods.name: TextReader(const TextReader& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new TextReader from an existing one.

methods.name: TextReader(TextReader&& move) noexcept
methods.description: Move constructor transferring ownership from a temporary TextReader.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the reading position to the beginning.

methods.name: EndOfText() const
methods.description: Checks if the end of the DataElement has been reached.

methods.name: ReadLine() const
methods.description: Reads a line of text from the DataElement.
